title: Verified crisis/support-resource directory (>=1 region)
context: QPL sets that touch distress, prognosis, end-of-life, or other sensitive topics must include verified crisis and support-line resources. Stale or wrong helpline information could cause direct harm to a distressed patient. The CI structural check (qpl-schema-001) will require a support-resources reference on any set with a sensitivity field; those references must point to verified entries in this directory. The directory must record verifiedBy and verifiedDate for each entry so staleness can be detected. This is a first-class M0 artifact, not an afterthought.
objective: Create support/resources.yaml — a structured, verified directory of crisis and cancer support lines for at least one region — and support/README.md explaining the schema, the verification process, and how to add new regions. Each entry must conform to supportResourceSchema (added in qpl-schema-001).
acceptanceCriteria: support/resources.yaml contains at least one verified region with: name, region (ISO country/region code), contact (phone/url), hours, url, verifiedBy (named individual), verifiedDate (ISO date), and a brief description of the service

The directory includes at minimum: a national cancer support/information line (e.g., NCI Cancer Information Service for the US region), a mental-health or distress line relevant to cancer patients, and a 988-equivalent (or regional crisis line) for at least one region
Each entry has been manually verified current — the contact information was tested or confirmed from the official source — before listing; verification method noted in verifiedBy/verifiedDate
support/resources.yaml validates against supportResourceSchema (from qpl-schema-001) in CI
support/README.md documents the schema fields, the verification procedure, how to add a new region, and the re-verification cadence requirement (to be checked on the qpl-refresh-001 cadence)
resources: PLAN.md (Data, licensing section — crisis/helpline info must be verified; Risks row for 'Crisis/helpline info wrong or stale')
988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline (988lifeline.org — relevant to cancer distress contexts)
